name: Orbio (Orbio AI, S.L.)
what: AI-native HR platform whose conversational agents run hiring, onboarding and retention for frontline (deskless) workforces, largely over WhatsApp.
homonym_note: Not Orbio Earth (methane-detection satellite analytics), Orbio World (Lithuania), the ORBIO / Orbio.so crypto token, or the 'Orbio' video game; all appear in Google News for the name.

notes: Visionaries' first check came in an undisclosed round before Sept 2025 (the company's own release on capital-riesgo.es says the $7.6M round was 'led for the second time by Visionaries Club'; tech.eu calls it 'existing investor'). No source gives that first round's name, date or size, so entry = undetermined. It was necessarily pre-Series A: the company was founded in early 2025 and launched in June 2025, and TFN (2026-06-15) says it raised 'about $28 million in total' since launch ($21M + $7.6M), so the first round was small or folded into the $7.6M. If the judge treats the first round as pre-seed/seed, the $21M Series A led by Dawn Capital (2026-06-15) is the graduation. HQ Madrid per the privacy policy (ORBIO AI, S.L., María de Molina 39, 28006 Madrid); CEO Sergi Bastardas founded Colvin (Barcelona), which is why Diari ARA covers it. Focus: the product is a set of autonomous HR agents, so AI & Applied AI (SaaS is the alternative).
